NOTIFICATION NO: 17/MRB/2025 DATE:23.01.2026
CORRIGENDUM
In partial modification of the Notification No.17/MRB/2025 dated:
21.11.2025 for the post of Assistant Surgeon (General),
(i) The para No.8 “CENTRE FOR EXAMINATION" is changed as detailed
below.
